# tests/fixtures/topdeck.gg/

**These are documentation-derived schema examples, NOT captured real API
responses.** They were hand-written to match the TopDeck Tournament Data API
v2 schema documented at https://topdeck.gg/docs/tournaments-v2 (read 2026-07-08)
so the parser can be developed and unit-tested before an API key exists.

Per CLAUDE.md (inspect before you parse), the TopDeck parser is NOT trusted —
and the source stays DISABLED in the daily chain — until 2-3 **real** captured
tournament responses replace these files and the parser is validated against
them. Card names used here are real Modern cards but the tournament, players,
and results are invented for structural testing only; card resolution is
validated on real data elsewhere.
